modules.name: WING-LINK
modules.description: Bridge to a Behringer WING over USB: 8 tracks as USB audio, names, colours and icons on the WING channels, faders, pan, sends, mute and solo both ways, CV in and out

modules.name: WING-LINK X
modules.description: Expander for WING-LINK: 8 more WING channels (docks right of WING-LINK, or links by right-click)

modules.name: WING-FX
modules.description: The WING's 16 effects from Rack, 4 at a time: model, on, mix and four parameters both ways, CV, delays in Rack's tempo or the WING's tempo as a clock (a panel of WING-LINK)

modules.name: WING-EQ
modules.description: The STD EQ and the filters of a WING channel from Rack: six bands with gain, frequency and Q, low and high cut, the curve, both ways, CV; the channel follows a strip, SELECT on the WING or pages with buttons (a panel of WING-LINK)

modules.name: WING-DYN
modules.description: The gate and the compressor (STD models) of a WING channel from Rack: threshold, range, ratio, gain, mix, knee, times, both ways, CV, the curve and the envelopes; the channel follows a strip, SELECT on the WING or pages with buttons (a panel of WING-LINK)

modules.name: WING-KNOBS
modules.description: The WING's custom controls as CV: 8 knobs (0-10 V) and 8 buttons (gates) learned from the WING's MIDI, each with a level (a panel of WING-LINK)

modules.name: WING-IN
modules.description: Audio from the WING into Rack: 8 USB outputs of the WING as 8 strips, each with its source on the WING (an input, or a channel, bus, main or matrix through a user signal), SYNC writes the routing, meters, levels (a panel of WING-LINK)
